blocks.text: Detecting and preventing intrusions means identifying and stopping unauthorized access to a computer or network. Cyber intrusions can occur when hackers exploit weaknesses to steal data or damage systems. Monitoring tools and security software help track unusual activity that might indicate an attack. Students learn how early detection prevents major losses and keeps systems running safely. Staying alert and updating security measures are key steps to maintaining protection against intrusions.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Students look at sample system logs or screenshots to find suspicious actions.
